fun main() {
  val registry = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val repoContext = readRepoFile(".repo_context/README.md, .repo_context/index.md, .repo_context/maintenance.md, .repo_context/generated/repo_index.md, .repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val prInputs = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json, /tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt, /tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff, /tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val docCandidates = runCommand("rg --files and rg relevant doc terms under docs cli .repo_context")
  val relevantDocs = readRepoFile("docs/source_zh_cn/deployment/dscli.md, .repo_context/modules/overview/repository-overview.md")
  val cliSource = readRepoFile("cli/command.py, cli file listing and net_check symbol search")
  val selfVerification = readRepoFile(".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
  val verdict = compute(registry, repoContext, prInputs, docCandidates, relevantDocs, cliSource, selfVerification)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", verdict)
  publish("safeoutputs/noop", "No GitHub action needed: docs preflight evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json.")
}
